reason: Trio-ViT combines post-training quantization and a dedicated accelerator for softmax-free vision transformers, reporting up to 3.6x–7.3x FPS gains at comparable accuracy. It is a concrete transformer quantization/accelerator result, but experiments are ViT-only and transfer to NLP is unestablished.
title: Trio-ViT: Post-Training Quantization and Acceleration for Softmax-Free Efficient Vision Transformer
